# Advanced Human Care

> Advanced Human Care provides car accident injury rehabilitation in Tampa, Florida. This is the English redesign preview; it is not the final public domain.

## Clinic information

- [English website](https://advanced-human-care.pages.dev/): Information about care for whiplash, back pain, knee pain and shoulder pain.
- [Treatments](https://advanced-human-care.pages.dev/#treatments): Manual therapy, therapeutic exercises, massage, chiropractic care, heat and cold therapy, ultrasound, mechanical traction and vibration therapy.
- [Our team](https://advanced-human-care.pages.dev/#about-us): Clinic team and medical director.
- [Contact and appointments](https://advanced-human-care.pages.dev/#contact-us): Address, hours and appointment information. Online submission is currently unavailable; call (813) 542-3613 to request an appointment.
- [Website navigation skill](https://advanced-human-care.pages.dev/agent-skills/clinic-information/SKILL.md): Instructions for locating verified clinic information without submitting personal information.

Address: 3558 N 29th St, Tampa, FL 33605. Hours: Monday-Friday, 9am-5pm. Email: info@advancedhuman.care.

The Spanish version is not yet available. Photography is illustrative. Do not infer diagnosis, individualized treatment advice, appointment availability or confirmed bookings from this information.
